verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own docs state that it offers role-based access control for fine-grained control over who can access which resources, and the pricing page lists RBAC. Organizations let teams share collections and environments securely. The evidence is thin on specifics: it does not show distinct view versus edit roles or which resources (APIs, collections) the permissions apply to. missing for 10: documented role definitions separating view and edit permissions, per-API/per-collection permission scoping details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can control who can view or edit APIs and collections with roles and permissions

citations.quote: Use Role-based access control (RBAC) for fine-grain control over who can access which Insomnia resources.
Insomnia organizations allows users to share collections and environments safely and securely with their colleagues.
